overview_description.description:
Gainsight’s customer success technology helps businesses retain customers and drive company growth. Its innovative customer-centric technology is driving the future of customer success. The company’s customer cloud offers a powerful set of solutions focused on customer success, product experience, revenue optimization, customer experience, and customer data, that together enable businesses to put the customer at the center of everything they do.

The company was founded in 2009 and is headquartered in San Francisco, California.

product.name: Gainsight Customer Platform
product.description: A customer success platform for centralizing customer data, managing post-sales processes, and supporting retention, expansion, and customer outcomes.

product.name: Gainsight Customer Success
product.description: Customer success software for managing customer relationships, measuring account health, coordinating engagement, and improving retention and expansion outcomes.

product.name: Gainsight Product Experience
product.description: Product analytics and in-app engagement software that helps teams understand product usage, collect feedback, and improve adoption across web, mobile, and desktop products.

product.name: Skilljar by Gainsight
product.description: A customer education platform for creating and managing online academies, courses, and training programs for customers, partners, and employees.

product.name: Gainsight Customer Communities
product.description: Community software for building branded customer spaces that support engagement, knowledge sharing, self-service, and customer education.

product.name: Staircase AI by Gainsight
product.description: An AI-based customer intelligence product that analyzes customer communications and interactions to identify relationship signals, risks, and opportunities.
